sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe a single published construct: mCherry fused in-frame at the C-terminus of OPN3 (before the stop codon in exon 4), validated in a CRISPR knock-in mouse. OPN3 is a 7-TM opsin with standard GPCR topology: the N-terminus (residues 1–43) is extracellular and the C-terminus (residues 313–402) is intracellular. A tag appended after residue 402 therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface. No ledger line describes a tag in any extracellular loop (ECL1: 101–114, ECL2: 177–202, ECL3: 277–289) or at the extracellular N-terminus. Because the sole published insertion is intracellular, zero extracellular surface sites are supported by the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: mCherry fused at the C-terminus of OPN3 (after residue 402, before the stop codon); the C-terminus lies in the intracellular domain (topology landmarks: INTRACELLULAR 313–402), so this is a cytoplasmic tag, not a surface tag. Validated for correct localization and function in melanocytes and knock-in mouse (L3, L4).
